reason: Exact recovery is not sufficiently established. No comparable whole-pattern Rwp was supplied, and the only reported fit is a fixed-width stick-profile cosine of 0.858; under its own optimal scale this still corresponds to a large relative L2 residual (~0.514), with major observed peaks substantially underfit and many extra calculated peaks. The trajectory first supported a ~169.5 A^3 primitive/Z=2 (or ~349 A^3 centered) pseudocubic metric, but submitted a materially different 135.84 A^3 Z=1 cell without demonstrating an equally complete indexing or a rigorous cell comparison. The P1 coordinates were obtained by freeing all eight non-Y atoms from a convenient tetrahedral motif, not by comparing well-defined ordered alternatives or refining a crystallographic whole-pattern model. This relaxation drove contacts to the imposed 1.45 A penalty boundary (including ~1.451 A Rh-B and Y-B), so physical plausibility is dubious and the improved surrogate score is consistent with overfitting. The trace therefore gives, at best, partial support for a low-symmetry/pseudocubic average framework; it does not establish the submitted cell/Z, P1 symmetry, coordinates, occupancies, or element ordering, and scientifically motivated Z=2 and other ordered framework candidates remain plausible.
